# Run ledger — P26.13 (open-data-catalog sweep: systematic camreg discovery)

## Spec / Base / Branch / Config

- **Spec:** `docs/tickets/P26.13__open-data-catalog-sweep.md` (SOURCES.12,
  manifest row 110) — turns P26.9's hand-picked camreg coverage into systematic
  catalog discovery: enumerate surveillance-relevant datasets through the
  Socrata / ArcGIS Hub / CKAN-DCAT catalog APIs, qualify each candidate
  honestly, and wire the verbatim-clear registries through the existing
  `dot_511` / `socrata_rows` connector path — registry records only, never
  media/person/plate data.
- **Branch:** `devin/p26-13-catalog-sweep` — stacked on
  `devin/p26-12-congress-legislation` (PR #104). Head at hosted run: `1467406`.
- **Date:** 2026-09-18. Same GCP posture as P26.8–P26.12: user account
  `14stevevitali@gmail.com` on `zeta-medley-508121-u7`; per-job upserts
  (`gcloud run jobs deploy`), never `scheduled-ops.sh --apply` (host ADC file
  corrupt, as recorded). Local Docker unresponsive again — the hosted image was
  built with **Cloud Build** (`ops/Dockerfile`, repo-root context).

## What landed

### 1. Enumeration — `catalog_sweep.py` + three committed artifacts

`docs/build/tools/catalog_sweep.py` enumerates three catalog APIs — Socrata
(`api.us.socrata.com/api/catalog/v1`, per-domain `q`+`limit`+`offset`), ArcGIS
Hub (`hub.arcgis.com/api/search/v1/collections/all/items`, `q`+`startindex`),
and CKAN (`data.gov.uk/api/3/action/package_search` — `catalog.data.gov`
returned 404, recorded). **3,257 candidates** enumerated (≫ the ≥50 / ≥2-API
floor) into committed provenance:

- `docs/build/reports/catalog_sweep_2026-09-18.json` — raw enumeration.
- `…_qualified.json` — per-candidate robots + licence probe evidence.
- `…_reviewed.json` — the reviewed outcome per row:

| verdict | rows |
|---|---|
| camera_registry (shaped) | 278 |
| — clear verbatim licence | 21 |
| — gated (licence unclear/absent) | 257 |
| probe error (DNS/SSL/503/no-layer) | 68 |
| non_target (health/epi surveillance, violations, ALPR reads, …) | 2,911 |

The review pass reclassified the false-positive families the keyword match
admits — epidemiological "surveillance" datasets, red-light *violation*
statistics, ALPR *read* feeds — as `non_target` with reasons; errors are
preserved as `error`, never dropped.

### 2. Rights — 10 flips with packets, 258 gated

Of the 21 verbatim-clear registries, **10** were wired (the 11th clear row,
`camreg_stalbert_ab`, was reverted to gated when its licence page proved to be
a JS-rendered shell — a licence NAME without captured grant text is not a
rights basis):

| source | licence → compartment |
|---|---|
| camreg_washington_dc, camreg_goldcoast_au | CC-BY-4.0 → `sig_graph` |
| camreg_nottingham_gb, camreg_york_gb, camreg_glasgow_gb, camreg_northayrshire_gb, camreg_lambeth_gb | OGL-3.0 → `ogl_uk3` |
| camreg_peel_on | LicenseRef-Peel-ODL-1.0 (Wayback-captured grant) → `peel_odl1` |
| camreg_rochester_ny | ODbL-1.0 → `osm_physical` (kept separate) |
| camreg_puertogaitan_co | CC-BY-SA-4.0 → `portal` (kept separate) |

New `licenses.toml` rows: `LicenseRef-Peel-ODL-1.0` (+ `peel_odl1`
compartment) and `LicenseRef-StAlbert-ODL-1.0` (+ `stalbert_odl1`
compartment — pre-registered, unused until the verbatim blocker resolves).
Each flipped source has `docs/build/reports/rights/camreg_<id>.md` quoting the
terms verbatim with retrieval dates, compartment analysis, and reviewer
decision. The 257 gated rows + 68 error rows + St. Albert are the named worklist
under **D-SOURCES.12-1**.

### 3. Wiring

- `camera_registry_targets.toml` +11 rows (10 flipped + stalbert in the gated
  section); `sources.toml` +11 (187 → **198** registered, 66 → **76**
  loadable); `live_targets.toml` +11 source sections (76 → **87**).
- `runner.py` maps all 11 `camreg_*` to `dot_511`; `api_allowlist.toml` gains
  the new Socrata/ArcGIS hosts with terms basis.
- `dot_511_vocab.toml` → `2026.09.18.2`: observed aliases — UK `CAMERA_ID`/
  `CCTV_NUMBER`/`SITE_ID`/`WARD`/`DIVISION`, Peel `CAMERA_NUM`/`Street`/
  `StrInt1`/`StrInt2`/`MUN`, DC `ADDRESS`/`PSA`/`STATUS`, Gold Coast `NAME`,
  Puerto Gaitán `latitud`/`longitud`/`georeferencia`/`nombre`/`sector`.
  Projected `EASTING`/`NORTHING`/`POINT_X`/`POINT_Y` deliberately NOT aliased —
  `outSR=4326` geometry stays the coordinate source (Lambeth BNG, Gold Coast
  MGA56 fields ride `excluded_fields`).
- `ops/cadence.toml` +10 monthly rows (`sig-ingest-camreg-*`, staggered
  12:00–18:00 UTC days 28–29); stalbert gets no job.

## Deterministic gate

- `make check` green: ruff, format, mypy 231 files, **3308 passed / 58
  skipped**, verify-gen clean.
- New P26.13 `test_dot_511.py` tests over committed fixtures (real Lambeth
  ArcGIS + Puerto Gaitán Socrata captures): alias resolution, jurisdiction
  schemes, projected-coord exclusion, gated-source refusal.
- `test_review_status.py` / `test_source_registry.py` counts re-baselined
  (198 / 76 / `_FLIPPED_SUBSET` +10); `sig-connectors validate` green;
  `sig-ops cadence --check` green; `make docs-check` green (1 pre-existing
  BM-ADR-04 warning).
- **Hygiene fix on the base:** `docs/build/pr/P26.12.md` line 72 quoted the
  `SIG_DATA_GOV_KEY`→`sig-data-gov-key` Secret Manager *name* binding, which
  the tracked-tree secret scanner flags by shape — rewritten unquoted (a
  name, never a value; the scanner exempts `secrets={}` bindings, not prose
  literals).

## Deferred (DEFERRALS.md)

**D-SOURCES.12-1** opened and stays OPEN — the reviewer gate over: 257
camera-registry-shaped datasets without a clear verbatim licence grant; 68
probe-error rows; and, named individually, `camreg_stalbert_ab` (licence name
observed, grant text a JS shell — no Wayback, not Hub-searchable). Nothing
gated was fetched; the reviewed artifact's gated rows carry `spdx=null` +
`blocker` fields as the enumerable worklist.
